definitions.supplemental: Piers P. blete: Orm. blætenn: Dut. bleeten, bláten: M. Dut. bleten: Ger. blaszen: O. H. Ger. blazan to cry as a sheep or goat, to bleat.

quotations.old_english: Hit biþ swíðe dyslíc ðæt se man beorce oððe blǽte
quotations.english: it is very foolish that the man bark or bleat

source_text: BLÆ-acute;TAN; p. blǽtte; pp. blǽtted; v. n. [blǽt a bleat] To BLEAT; balare :-- Ic blǽte swá gát I bleat as a goat, Exon. 106 b; Th. 406,17; Rä. 25, 2. Scǽp blǽt ovis balat, Ælfc. Gr. 22; Som. 24, 9. Hit biþ swíðe dyslíc ðæt se man beorce oððe blǽte it is very foolish that the man bark or bleat, 22; Som. 24, 12. [Piers P. blete: Orm. blætenn: Dut. bleeten, bláten: M. Dut. bleten: Ger. blaszen: O. H. Ger. blazan to cry as a sheep or goat, to bleat.]
